definition: to get on the bus just in time
description: On a city street at dusk after rain, a laughing young woman with curly hair, a camel coat and white trainers leaps through the air towards the open door of a red bus, holding a stack of white gift boxes above her head, while her silk scarf falls into a puddle. She lands inside the bus, passengers wave and clap at the windows, a pigeon flaps up, and the doors close. The bus then drives away from the glass shelter, leaving the scarf lying on the wet pavement.

taps.phrase: to drive away from the stop
